mission_09: Excellent work building a comprehensive forecast evaluation framework! You now understand that no single metric tells the whole story about forecast quality. MAE gives you the average error in interpretable units, RMSE highlights the impact of large errors, MAPE and SMAPE enable scale-free comparisons, and MASE provides a benchmark against the naive forecast. The pinball loss you implemented is the foundation for quantile regression evaluation, enabling you to assess the quality of probabilistic forecasts at different quantile levels. The Diebold-Mariano test provides rigorous statistical comparison between competing models, accounting for the temporal dependence in forecast errors. This evaluation toolkit empowers you to make data-driven decisions about which forecasting model to deploy, communicate forecast uncertainty to stakeholders, and continuously monitor model performance in production environments.
